Had a very good experience with Karma IT Hub, Mumbai. I ordered a custom high-end PC remotely while being in London, and the seller was extremely cooperative throughout the entire process.

They handled everything transparently over WhatsApp calls and video verification, shared live hardware checks, serial numbers, invoices, BIOS/system verification, and patiently answered all technical questions. The communication was professional and trustworthy.

Really appreciated the effort to keep the process clean and transparent for a remote buyer. The build quality, coordination, and responsiveness were excellent.

Recommended for anyone looking for custom PC builds and genuine support.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really good experience with KARMA IT HUB at Lamington Road. featured_reviews.name: nikhil patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently built a custom PC from Karma IT Hub, and my experience was really good. I provided them with a list of all the parts I wanted, and they managed to arrange everything all genuine with serial number matching— even the components that most other stores said were discontinued or out of stock.

They did charge a bit more for the graphics card since that particular variant was hard to find anywhere, but honestly, it was worth it. I had checked with several other stores, and everyone else was either trying to push alternative parts or claiming the components were no longer available.

The team at Karma IT Hub delivered exactly what I asked for without any excuses. Prices are slightly on the higher side, but fair — and if you negotiate, they’re reasonable. They also assembled the PC free of cost, which was a nice bonus.

This was my third custom PC build from different stores, and Karma IT Hub has been the best experience so far. Much better value and service compared to ABGB, which I found overpriced and over hyped. Just do your research, know what you need, and these guys will make it happen for you. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Drashtant Bosmiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had given my PC to this shop a few weeks ago for a general check-up and cleaning, as I was initially planning to get it upgraded. Although the upgrade didn’t go through, they informed me that the parts had been tested and the PC was cleaned, so I agreed to pay the bill, which came to ₹3,300. I found the price quite steep just for cleaning and part inspection, but I chose not to argue and paid it anyway.

However, when the PC was returned to me today, I was extremely disappointed. There was still visible dust and even spider webs inside, clearly no proper cleaning had been done. To make matters worse, my CPU cooler was missing. When I called them about it, they casually said, “Yeah, it’s here, you can take it if you still want it.”

This level of service is completely unprofessional, and I definitely won’t be returning or recommending this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent experience with this store(Karma IT Hub) was extremely disappointing and completely avoidable.

I purchased a custom PC worth ₹94,000, and at the time of purchase, the store staff never informed me that GST was not included.
Only after the payment was completed, I was suddenly told that I must pay an additional 18% to receive a GST bill.

This is misleading, unprofessional, and unethical.

To make things worse, I even have a WhatsApp chat where the staff clearly says
“18% lagega for GST bill” — AFTER the payment was already done.

This proves everything:
No transparency at the time of purchase
Crucial information hidden by the seller
Attempt to add unexpected charges later

The owner later resolved the issue when I contacted him directly, and I appreciate that —
but the damage is already done.
If the owner is not present, customers are left at the mercy of staff who don’t communicate properly and try to surprise you with extra charges afterward.

WARNING for future customers:

Before buying anything from this store:
1 -Confirm clearly whether GST is included
2-Ask the final amount including all taxes
3-Don’t rely on verbal promises
4-Take everything in writing or WhatsApp

When you're paying yuor almost one lakh hard earned,  rupees, you expect transparency, not last-minute shocks.

This experience has made me lose confidence in their process, and I genuinely hope the store fixes these issues.
Until then, I cannot recommend this place to anyone who values honest and upfront pricing.
